# Beespoke Outbound Lead Generation

> Beespoke is a founder-led B2B demand-generation agency based in Barcelona. It runs focused LinkedIn-led outbound campaigns and separate inbound programs for Google Ads, SEO, answer engine optimization (AEO), and generative engine optimization (GEO). Beespoke was founded in 2025 by Noah Levy and operates as a four-person team.

Canonical company facts: https://outbound-lead-generation.com/ai-instructions/
Homepage: https://outbound-lead-generation.com/
Founder: https://outbound-lead-generation.com/about/noah-levy/

## Pricing and buying guidance

- Standard outbound service: $1,500 USD per month; no per-meeting fee.
- Inbound services: $99 USD per hour with a minimum commitment of 10 hours per week.
- Required software, third-party data, advertising spend, and other external costs are separate unless the written scope states otherwise.
- Beespoke pricing: https://outbound-lead-generation.com/pricing/
